column3: “Torn apart” is rendered “split apart,” and “fatty ash” as “ashes.”
“Entreat the face of the LORD” is rendered “entreat the LORD.”
The Hebrew “He commanded me” is rendered passively, “it was commanded me.”
The Hebrew reads “his son came” (singular) and then “they recounted”; NASB has “his sons.”
The Hebrew “his sons had seen” may also be read “his sons showed”; NASB keeps “had seen.”
“A word was to me” is rendered “a command came to me.”
“The mouth of the LORD” is rendered “the command of the LORD.”
“The mouth of the LORD” is rendered “the command of the LORD,” and NASB adds “therefore.”
